span.p:
LOCK 3 — AWS TRUST POLICY
The apply role is assumable only when the OIDC subject
contains environment:dev or environment:prod.
GitHub issues that claim only to a job declaring the
environment, and such a job cannot start until approved.
Approval is a precondition for write credentials.
